主要内容: Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. ratified the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2017. The vote results were: For 61,872,171, Against 1,793,130, Abstain 225,684, Broker Non-Votes 0. The report was signed by Alexander D. Macrae, President and Chief Executive Officer, on June 6, 2017.
